title: WorkBuddy Connect Community
zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 WorkBuddy，
沿用桌面登录，连接模型与上下文选项。
en: WorkBuddy access in DeepSeek Harness,
using desktop sign-in and context options.

title: PR & Release Workspace
zh: 阅读 PR 与差异，保留本地笔记，
核对版本与发布记录。
en: Read PRs and diffs, keep local notes,
and check versions and release records.

title: DrawAI Video Studio
zh: 用 Remotion / React 制作视频，
从分镜、可编辑场景到渲染与画面检查。
en: Make videos with Remotion and React,
from storyboards to rendering and review.

title: OJ NEXUS
zh: Android 多 OJ 客户端，集中管理账号、
题目、提交、比赛与训练记录。
en: An Android client for multiple judges:
accounts, problems, contests and training.

title: CSP-2026
zh: CSP-J/S 2026 试题与选手文件归档，
支持在线阅读、代码对比与按需下载。
en: CSP-J/S 2026 papers and contestant files,
with online reading and code comparison.

title: oi-coach
zh: 面向 OI 的教学技能：讲解与分级提示、
代码批改、训练反馈和赛后复盘。
en: An OI coaching skill: explanations, hints,
code review and post-contest reflection.

title: evidence-learning
zh: 整理学习证据、复习与延迟复测，
让学习记录能在之后继续用上。
en: Study evidence, review and delayed practice,
keeping learning records useful over time.

title: Harness Hub
zh: 本地优先的 AI 编程桌面控制中心，
管理项目、Harness、终端会话与 Git 变更。
en: A local-first desktop hub for AI coding:
projects, harnesses, sessions and Git changes.

title: DSH Plugin Market
zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件索引，
查看插件来源、版本与安装入口。
en: A community DeepSeek Harness plugin index,
with sources, versions and install links.

title: dsh-plugins-sync
zh: 汇集多来源插件目录与快照，
核对版本、通道和冲突。
en: Plugin catalogs and snapshots from sources,
with version, channel and conflict checks.

title: Personal website
zh: 项目、博客与独立运行的小实验，
也用可视化探索数学和物理现象。
en: Projects, posts and independent experiments,
exploring mathematics and physics visually.

title: Provider Doctor
zh: 沿宿主、安装、注册与凭据等环节，
定位模型连接问题。
en: Diagnose model connections through the host,
installation, registration and credentials.

title: Version Manager
zh: 查看插件与 Skills 的实际安装状态，
检查更新预览和快照。
en: Inspect installed plugins and skills,
with update previews and snapshots.

title: ZCode Plan Bridge
zh: 将 DSH 的模型请求交给本机
已经登录的 ZCode CLI。
en: Route DSH model requests through the local,
already signed-in ZCode CLI.
